title: Property & Casualty
meta_description: P&C economics live in two moments: pricing the risk before the event and handling the claim after it.

blocks.x: What Property & Casualty means at Achala IT Solutions: the scope we sign, the architecture we ship, the evidence generated in-flight, and the per 1,000 claims outcomes measured against your audited baseline.
Property & Casualty is delivered inside your operating context: the rules you are held to, the latency your decisions need, and the systems your teams already trust.

blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Property & Casualty
blocks.note: The flow is linear on purpose: every hop owns its latency budget and failure policy, and a regression in one stage is a cohort, never an estate-wide surprise.

blocks.x: What holds Property & Casualty together is discipline at the boundaries — typed contracts between stages, versioned releases, and a replay trail for every decision. The diagram above shows how the pieces compose; the gate reviews are what keep them honest.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Silent schema drift
Contracts enforced at the boundary — schema drift fails the pipeline loudly, in minutes.
Metric anarchy
One definition per metric, owned and versioned — the dashboard and the board pack cannot disagree.
Cost creep
Unit costs on a published budget with alerts at the threshold — creep is caught by the meter, not by the invoice.

blocks.x: The engagement pattern for Property & Casualty: diagnose, prove, industrialize, compound. Each gate reviews evidence with your named owners, and each gate can stop the program.

items: Claims cycle time
Claims cycle time moves at gates, not in slideware: the value claimed at each gate is reconciled with your team before it enters the ledger.
Leakage rate
Leakage rate is tracked weekly against the baseline signed in week two — the number at each gate is the number finance sees.
Filing prep effort
Filing prep effort defines success for this pattern and is audited against the week-two baseline at every gate
Instrumented-preventable losses
Instrumented-preventable losses is tracked weekly to your control owner; the number at gate three is the number finance sees
